In plain words What this file contains What calls what Items

Run the real check once, by hand.

cargo run -p veilvoice-update --example ask

Not a test: it reaches the network, and a test suite that does is a test suite that fails on a train. This exists so the thing can be tried against the real page before it is believed.

In plain words

A short example of asking whether a newer version has been published.

It shows the same thing the application's button does, including that the answer only tells you what a release page currently says.
